steps: a) Alec lived in a small old house in the country: two rooms, a small kitchen, a bathroom and a toilet. It wasn't very comfortable or clean. There were flowers in front of it and fruit trees behind it.
b) His new flat in Moscow is small but clean and comfortable: three rooms, a kitchen, a bathroom and a toilet. His room has a desk, a bookcase, yellow walls with pictures and a brown carpet.
c) I live in a flat in Moscow: two rooms, a kitchen, a bathroom and a toilet. My room is clean and comfortable — a bed, a desk, a chair, two bookcases, blue walls with posters and a dark blue carpet.
